items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I became very good friends with old man Bill Reedy

ctx.x: Yeah. But Curly, you knew Curly over there and did you play with him? No. See, I just was curious about that. Well you're talking about your work and everything. Did you, when did you start tuning pianos?

Well, after I started to work for Whirlions, how I learned it was at every spare moment of my time I would go into the tuning shop, into the repair shop of Whirlions. And I became very good friends with old man Bill Reedy, who was one of the finest piano technicians that I ever met in all my life and wouldn't tell anybody anything. But I'm the only one that he would let sit there because once in a while he loved his booze and I'd slip him a half a pint. And he thought the world of me, but he'd run the hell out of…
And have you ever taught anybody what you know?
